title: Identify the league in the 2015/2016 season whose teams, on average, scored
question: Identify the league in the 2015/2016 season whose teams, on average, scored the fewest total goals per match (home and away combined), and return only the league name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT t2."XCL_005"
FROM Match AS t1
INNER JOIN League AS t2 ON t1."XCL_008" = t2."XCL_003"
WHERE t1."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY t2."XCL_005"
ORDER BY AVG(t1."XCL_015" + t1."XCL_016") ASC
LIMIT 1
